ModManifest.Name: 信用点收支显示&账本：好好记账
ModManifest.Author: 一万万
ModManifest.Description:
把每天的信用点收支记清楚。
《信用点收支显示&账本：好好记账》将账本整合进游戏原生日历。点击“账本”标签查看当天记录，也可切换回看昨天；打开日历保留原版默认页面。
### 账本功能
- 汇总每日收入、支出与净额 - 分列显示收支方向、顾客、交易类型、物品、明细、金额与成交后剩余信用点 - 记录成交时生效的事件、顾客、物品状态、议价及批发价格修正 - 显示完整物品或容器名称及液体、能源等容量规格 - 仅折叠相邻且同名、同规格、同成交单价、同价格修正的物品，并标注数量 - 支持分页查看；账本随当前游戏存档保存与读取
账本记录顾客交易及游戏内各类信用点结算，帮助你核对每天的资金变化。
---
### Keep Your Books Straight
Keep every credit movement easy to review. Open the Ledger tab in the in-game calendar to see today's transactions, or switch to yesterday. Opening the calendar keeps the game's original default page.
### Ledger Features
- See daily totals for income, expenses, and net balance - Separate columns show direction, customer, transaction type, item, details, amount, and the balance after settlement - Record applied event, customer, condition, negotiation, and wholesale price modifiers - See full container names, liquid volumes, energy levels, and capacities - Fold only adjacent identical items with matching specifications, unit prices, and price modifiers - Browse paginated records; ledger data is saved and restored with the active game save
Customer trades and in-game credit settlements are recorded from their actual balance changes, helping you keep track of where your money went.
